name: Omapostal
author: murjax
description: Postman-style HTTP request widget for the bar: saved request groups with default headers, auth and environments, plus a response viewer with history

barWidget.description: Send GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD/OPTIONS requests with custom headers and a body, and inspect status, timing, response headers and body. Keeps a history of recent requests to replay. Requests can be saved in groups (one JSON file each) that carry a base URL, default headers, default auth and named {{var}} environments.

schema.label: Request timeout (seconds)
schema.description: How long to wait for a response before giving up.

schema.label: History size
schema.description: How many recent requests to remember for replay.
